summary: Stocks are up across the board Tuesday as the AI rally extended and oil prices eased. Chip stocks led the tape, with AMD hitting another record on fresh analyst price target hikes tied to Meta's Muse AI agent boom.
market_note: S&P futures up 0.72%, VIX down 3% to 15.04 as risk appetite returns.

items.why: Citi raised its target to $800 and Mizuho to $705, saying Meta's Muse agent boom will drive massive chip demand. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially boost supply in 2027.
Prime Big Deal Days kicked off Tuesday with 48 hours of discounts. Shares also kept momentum from its Sept 30 nuclear power deal with Constellation.
Melius upgraded Microsoft to Buy with a $665 target, calling it AI's 'adults in charge'; Scotiabank raised its target to $615. Azure grew 43% in fiscal Q4.
Falling as the S&P and Nasdaq rally, with the AI trade and easing oil lifting the broader market.
